description: Business leads for a Google Maps search such as "dentist in Austin, TX": name, category, address, phone, website, e-mail addresses read from the business website with a deliverability grade, social links, rating, review count and a lead score. Suited to local lead generation and prospect lists. $0.007 per lead requested, 1 to 20 leads per call; a call typically takes 1 to 2 minutes.

emails.description: true (default): read each business website for e-mail addresses and grade the best one (primaryEmail, emails, emailValidation). false: faster, the e-mail fields are left out.

language.description: Language of the Google Maps listing as a 2-letter code (default en), e.g. de, fr, es.

limit.description: Maximum businesses (1 to 20, default 10). A search takes about 70 seconds to start and 5 to 8 seconds per business; after about 110 seconds it returns the businesses it has (a note says so), so a large limit can return fewer rows.

query.description: What to look for and where, 3 to 200 characters, e.g. "dentists in Austin, TX" or "Italian restaurants in Manhattan". Specific searches work better than broad ones.

socials.description: true (default): add the Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and TikTok links found on the website (socialMedia). false: socialMedia is left out.

name: maps_leads
title: Business leads from a Google Maps search, with e-mails
